The endpoint reads ticket lifecycle and linked workflow evidence to build proposal objects, reports writes_database=false, and cannot mutate the ticket, dispatch a workflow, decide approval, send externally, record a snapshot, deploy, or publish.

The endpoint executes one bounded SELECT over the smoke-certification ledger, filters secrets_included = 0 in SQL, and omits free-form notes and metadata_json from its safe projection; it cannot certify a smoke run, recertify a plugin, update policy, or dispatch a provider request.

The endpoint executes one bounded SELECT to resolve the most specific active smoke-recertification policy, omits free-form notes and metadata_json, and falls back in memory to a static default; it cannot upsert, roll back, or audit a policy.

The endpoint executes one bounded SELECT over the smoke-recertification policy registry and omits free-form notes and metadata_json from its normalized safe projection; it cannot upsert, roll back, or audit a policy.
The endpoint executes a bounded SELECT over execution-log audit rows, projects sanitized before and after policy summaries, and filters them in memory. It cannot upsert or roll back a policy.

The endpoint reads one sanitized audit snapshot and the current policy, computes changed fields in memory, and explicitly does not replay notes content. Applying rollback is a separate consequential operation.

The endpoint reads bounded certification, endpoint, connection-metadata, and policy rows and classifies recertification needs in memory. Recertification dispatch and certification updates are confined to the separate batch operation.
The endpoint performs bounded SELECT queries over remote-runtime targets and command allowlists and returns safe public projections. It cannot validate, probe, execute, deploy, or update a target.

The endpoint reads one safe contribution projection and evaluates owner scope, action binding, status, and credential-scope policy in memory. It cannot activate, promote, certify, dispatch, or mutate the platform base.
